**Networking Event: Meta-Research and Reproducibility**
</br>
Join us for an online networking session on November 11th, 2025, from 12:00–13:00 CET, facilitated by MERRI contributors Alex Bannach-Brown & Stephanie Zellers. This event offers an informal space to connect with others interested in meta-research, open science, and reproducibility. Whether you’re a seasoned researcher, early-career scholar, or simply curious about improving research practices, this is a chance to share ideas, exchange experiences, and expand your network.

Please register and recieve the zoom link, please enter your details [here.](https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/bfo2C942S_WjOof0LBGEJA){target="_blank"}

We look forward to seeing you!
